sara: Quick sync — Aurora Logistics asked for a 7-day joint POC. Must be Dedicated with VPC peering, SAML SSO, customer KMS, and a simple SLA. We need cost + a short tech runbook.
diego: They said EU+US. For ~100 rps steady (peaks ~150) I'd provision 4 GPUs steady, allow burst to 6. Ballpark infra for 7 days ~ $28k before discounts.
ivy: Security flagged: RSA-signed SAML cert, vendor questionnaire, and explicit token retention statement. Short answer: we do not persist raw prompts; we store minimal telemetry and hashed embeddings per contract.
sara: Contracts wants PO minimum $25k. Can we shape pricing so the POC meets that? Include PS for SSO & networking.
diego: With a 20% partner discount and $6k PS (2 eng days + networking), total comes to ~ $26.4k — should clear the PO threshold. I'll produce a concise cost table.
infra-bot: Provisioning staging tenant aurora-demo-2965 (7-day TTL)... complete. Tenant id: demo-aurora-2965. Creds delivered to secure channel.
ivy: I'll assemble the ISA responses and a one-page incident escalation runbook. Please include pen-test contact (no prod creds).
diego: I'll attach a terraform peering snippet and the infra cost calc, then we can send the bundle to the partner by EOD.
sara: Great — target EOD. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
